name: [Painting] Sfumato
nl: Sfumato rendering: tone carried through imperceptible steps, no contour left anywhere, form emerging out of smoke-soft transitions, warm dark ground glowing up through thin glazes, oil painting style image.

name: [Painting] Orphism
nl: Orphist rendering: prismatic discs and interlocking arcs, simultaneous contrasts of pure hue doing the work of light, rhythm built from colour alone, faceted overlaps without outline, painting style image.

name: [Painting] Bay Area Figurative
nl: Bay Area figurative rendering: thick loaded strokes left deliberately unresolved, high Californian daylight flattening the palette, drawing done with the brush itself, scraped-back passages showing earlier layers, oil painting style image.

name: [Painting] Quadratura Ceiling
nl: Quadratura rendering: illusionistic architecture in steep upward perspective, painted cornices and coffers continuing the real room, foreshortened forms crowding the rim, chalky plaster tone throughout, painting style image.

name: [Painting] Sinopia Underdrawing
nl: Sinopia rendering: red-earth underdrawing brushed straight onto damp plaster, confident single-pass contours, thin washes blocking the masses, lime-white ground breathing through everything, painting style image.

name: [Painting] Pronkstilleven
nl: Ostentatious still-life rendering: silver, glass and fruit piled in dark opulence, one raking light, wet reflections and dew rendered to a hair, deep varnished shadow swallowing the corners, oil painting style image.

name: [Painting] Bodegón
nl: Spanish bodegón rendering: a few humble objects spaced along a bare ledge, hard side light against a near-black ground, austere intervals, matte earthy palette with restrained highlights, oil painting style image.

name: [Painting] Capriccio Ruin Fantasy
nl: Capriccio rendering: invented ruins assembled beside real monuments, warm bituminous shadow, crumbling stone laid in dry scumbles, wide even daylight and a chalky distance, oil painting style image.

name: [Painting] Dutch Marine
nl: Dutch marine rendering: grey-green swell under a towering cloud bank, rigging picked out hair-thin against pale sky, low horizon far down the frame, silvery tonal restraint overall, oil painting style image.
negative: vivid tropical colour, flat poster shapes

name: [Painting] Cuzco School
nl: Cuzco-school rendering: Andean colonial devotional painting, gold brocade patterning laid flat over dark drapery, frontal hieratic poses, matte earth palette with red bole showing at the edges, painting style image.

name: [Painting] Ethiopian Church Painting
nl: Ethiopian church rendering: wide almond eyes and frontal stares, thick black contour around every shape, flat saturated red, yellow and green, banded borders enclosing each panel, painting style image.

name: [Painting] Kerala Mural
nl: Kerala mural rendering: ochre, indigo and terre-verte on lime plaster, elaborate crowns and jewellery drawn in fine line, rounded stylised anatomy, dense floral fill packing the ground, painting style image.

name: [Painting] Pahari Miniature
nl: Pahari rendering: soft hill country in cool thin washes, delicate courtly line, lyrical pastel palette, sparing gold accents, a generous plain band of sky above, painting style image.

name: [Painting] Amate Bark Painting
nl: Amate rendering: bright flat figures painted on mottled fig-bark paper, hard black outlines, symmetrical birds and blossoms, the fibrous uneven ground showing through everywhere, painting style image.

name: [Painting] Rosemaling
nl: Rosemaling rendering: Norwegian scrollwork in flowing C and S strokes, two tones blended on a single brush, ox-blood or blue-grey painted ground, cream linework tying the panels together, painting style image.
negative: geometric flat vector shapes, photographic depth

name: [Painting] Ndebele Wall Geometry
nl: Ndebele rendering: hard-edged geometric blocks in saturated colour, every field bound by a heavy black band, stepped symmetrical forms, chalky wall texture under the paint, painting style image.

name: [Illustration] Fraktur Folk Manuscript
nl: Fraktur rendering: Pennsylvania-German folk manuscript, tulips, hearts and paired birds in flat watercolour, ruled ink borders boxing each element, ornate blackletter flourishes, laid paper tone, drawing style image.

name: [Print] Gyotaku Fish Print
nl: Gyotaku rendering: sumi ink taken directly off the subject and pressed onto washi, scale and fin texture printed one to one, soft bleed at the margins, wide unprinted paper around it, print style image.

name: [Experimental] Sgraffito Plaster
nl: Sgraffito rendering: coloured plaster layers scratched back to reveal the tone beneath, incised line with a raised burr, flat fields of lime colour, chipped edges and trowel marks, material style image.

name: [Experimental] Verre Églomisé
nl: Reverse-glass rendering: gold leaf and paint applied behind glass and read through it, mirror-bright metal with engraved detail scratched into the leaf, glassy depth, dark backing sealing the panel, material style image.

name: [Experimental] Khokhloma Lacquer
nl: Khokhloma rendering: gold foliage and berries over deep black lacquer, vermilion accents, fine curling stems drawn in one stroke, glassy varnish depth catching the light, material style image.

name: [Experimental] Delftware Blue
nl: Delftware rendering: cobalt brushwork on white tin glaze, every tone drawn from one pigment, fine outline over broad wash, glaze pooling darker at the edges with a faint kiln crackle, material style image.
negative: full colour palette, matte paper texture
